description: A double-pole double-throw relay: one coil switches two independent circuits (poles 1 and 2) simultaneously.
how_to_use: COIL1/COIL2 are the coil (power) pins — not polarized as VCC/GND specifically, just the two coil terminals. P1/NC1/NO1 and P2/NC2/NO2 are the two independent switched circuits: each pole's common (P) connects to NC when the coil is unpowered, or to NO when powered — the two poles switch together but are electrically separate circuits from each other and from the coil.
